newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Post to raise A$50mln in note issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Post to raise A$50mln in note issue.

text.p: Australia Post said on Monday it would raise A$50 million through the issue of two-year floating rate notes.
The Commonwealth Bank of Australia will again manage the issue which will mature in March 1999.
The government-owned issuer said it will build on similar fund raisings since 1994 and take Australia Post's total borrowings to A$367.5 million.
The money will support Australia Post's planned capital expenditure which includes a five-year programme to boost the capacity of Post's domestic letter and parcel networks.
CBA expects strong demand for the notes reflecting the issuer's triple-A credit rating with Standard & Poor's.
